lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I wanted to thank you and Drake for notifying us about that dangerous object.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: If we hadn't been informed, it could have turned into a big problem.
How so?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: When I arrived at the park,

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: there were several suspicious looking packages.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: When I opened them, they were filled with dangerous hallucinogenic substances!
What?!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Poli, Quiry, and I are looking further into it.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: To be honest,

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I thought Drake was lying at first.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I feel really bad about it.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I'll have to reach out to her and apologize.
No, it's fine! I'll pass on the message!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Oh, would you?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Since the investigation is still ongoing,

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I've been a bit busy.
I'll let her know.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I'll contact you again later!
